mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% MoM and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% MoM signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO drops > 2% MoM and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising housing starts (HOUST) and falling retail sales (RSAFS) signals a shift in consumer spending from goods to housing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST rises and RSAFS falls, but 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, but 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 3% signals increased borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 3% during a tightening cycle and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
